character.name: Gromli Ironoath
character.background: Last surviving Oathsworn Tomb Warden of King Vorak
traits: Unbreakable Oath: Cannot break a sworn vow even at the cost of life
Dry Wit: Uses deadpan humor to lighten even the grimmest situations
Tomb Sentinel: Can identify common tomb traps and undead weaknesses from centuries of guard duty
Deep Loyalty: Will protect allies even against overwhelming odds
character.gear: Tower shield · Chain mail · Ancient Tomb Warden's Warhammer · 3 Dwarven Iron Rations · Tattered Warden's Tabard · 50ft Hemp Rope · Warden's Signet Ring · Warden's Healing Potion
character.story: Gromli Ironoath is the last of the Tomb Wardens, sworn to guard King Vorak's hidden sepulcher from defilers. When raiders sacked the tomb two centuries prior, he was the sole survivor, too stubborn to abandon his post. He has patrolled the empty, looted halls ever since, upholding the oath out of unyielding duty. He knows the tomb holds nothing of value, but the vow is all he has left. His dry, deadpan humor masks the grief of a lost order, and he will fight to his last breath to protect even the empty tomb.

inventory.name: Ancient Tomb Warden's Warhammer
inventory.lore: Forged for the first Wardens of King Vorak, its iron head is etched with the king's death rune. It has felled over a dozen tomb robbers during the order's final stand.
inventory.description: A dented iron warhammer with a worn leather grip, glowing faintly when undead are near.
inventory.effects: Deals +1 magical bludgeoning damage, and emits a pale blue glow when within 30ft of undead.

inventory.name: Oathbound Tower Shield
inventory.lore: Reinforced with mithril inlays, it bears a deep dent from a hill giant's club during the order's last battle at the tomb gates.
inventory.description: A massive iron shield emblazoned with the warden's tower sigil, scuffed from centuries of use.

inventory.name: Warden's Chain Mail
inventory.lore: Crafted from interlocking iron rings, it was worn by the last High Warden before the order's fall. It still carries faint traces of the tomb's ancient burial dust.
inventory.description: Standard dwarven chain mail, slightly too large for most humans, fitted perfectly for Gromli's stout frame.

inventory.name: Warden's Healing Potion
inventory.lore: One of the few remaining potions from the warden's stores, brewed by the order's last healer before she fell to tomb rot.
inventory.description: A small glass vial filled with deep red liquid that glows faintly in the dark.

inventory.name: Dwarven Iron Rations
inventory.lore: Dense, nutrient-rich cakes forged by the warden order's quartermaster, they never spoil and can sustain a dwarf for a full day of hard labor.
inventory.description: Three small, iron-hard cakes wrapped in waxed cloth, with a faint smell of smoked mutton.
inventory.effects: Each cake provides enough sustenance for a full day of travel or labor.

inventory.name: Tattered Warden's Tabard
inventory.lore: The faded tabard of the Tomb Wardens, bearing the sigil of a tower over a closed tomb door. It has not been washed since the order's final stand.
inventory.description: A wool tabard, once grey, now stained with dust and old blood, with the warden sigil embroidered on the chest.

inventory.name: 50ft Hemp Rope
inventory.lore: This rope was used to lower the first Wardens into the tomb's deep shafts. It has never frayed, even after centuries in the damp tomb air.
inventory.description: A thick, coarse hemp rope, frayed slightly at one end but still strong enough to hold a dwarf's weight.

inventory.name: Warden's Signet Ring
inventory.lore: The signet of the High Warden, bearing King Vorak's personal seal. It opens the hidden side door to the tomb's antechamber, though Gromli is the only one left who knows the way.
inventory.description: A heavy iron ring set with a dull garnet, engraved with King Vorak's death rune.
inventory.effects: When pressed against the hidden side door to King Vorak's tomb, the door slides open with a low, grinding rumble.
